crossBorderPolicy.title: Nigeria WebGIS cross-border geographic data policy

geographicReference.diagnostic_land_mask: Dissolved admin_states_gadm_pg excluding the non-administrative Water body / Lake Chad row
geographicReference.diagnostic_country_context: reference_africa_countries_pg (Natural Earth) for neighbouring-country and marine diagnostics
geographicReference.legal_status: Diagnostic references only; none is a legal boundary, territorial-sea delineation or proof of sovereignty
geographicReference.lake_chad_rule: Do not count Water body / Lake Chad as a Nigerian state or LGA or treat the whole lake as Nigerian land
geographicReference.marine_rule: Outside the land mask may mean valid marine or coastal context; it does not by itself mean a coordinate error or an EEZ determination

nationalAggregationRules.feature_counts: Use an explicit, named Nigeria analysis mask. Separate wholly inside, intersecting/boundary, foreign-only and marine/unassigned counts; never equate an extraction bounding box with Nigeria.
nationalAggregationRules.point_measurements: Classify by actual point geometry and report boundary, marine and foreign context separately. Do not assign a foreign point to the nearest Nigerian state or LGA.
nationalAggregationRules.area_and_length: For a Nigeria-only measurement, intersect a copy with the named analysis mask and label the result as clipped. Preserve the source geometry and also disclose whole-feature totals where relevant.
nationalAggregationRules.transboundary_systems: Report the whole-system total separately from the Nigeria-only clipped portion. Never add a whole transboundary area or length to a Nigeria total without labelling it.
nationalAggregationRules.rasters: Use both the analysis mask and the source valid-data mask. NoData outside Nigeria or outside source coverage is not zero and must not be interpolated solely to complete a national total.
nationalAggregationRules.regional_reference: Exclude regional/global reference and map-sheet furniture from Nigeria thematic totals unless a separate, explicitly clipped derivative is documented.
nationalAggregationRules.current_application: Catalog metadata states the required interpretation; the generic Area summary is focus-area based and is not an automatic sovereignty or country filter.

nigeria_focused.description: Nigeria is the intended thematic or administrative scope. Boundary/generalisation differences require review, while foreign-only features are not automatically accepted.

nigeria_with_context.description: A Nigeria extraction intentionally includes neighbouring-country, coastal or marine context. Context remains visible and must not become a Nigerian administrative assignment or national total.

transboundary_system.description: A natural, cultural or network feature can continue across an international border. Preserve the whole feature and distinguish whole-system from Nigeria-only measurements.

regional_reference.description: A regional, continental, global or boundary-reference layer is not a Nigeria-only thematic total.

map_sheet.description: A scanned-sheet derivative or map-sheet furnishing can include neighbouring countries, marginalia, graticules and boundary lines outside the land mask.

raster_window.description: A numeric raster has a source grid/window and valid-data mask. Geographic window and NoData semantics take precedence over a rectangular Nigeria assumption.

layers.label: General (picture)
layers.description: General (small-scale) geology of Nigeria digitised from general-geology-map-of-nigeria.png (615x715 px, ~2.5 km/px) into 8 colour classes of its legend. Quaternary alluvium and Mesozoic sediments share one pale-yellow legend colour on the picture and cannot be separated by colour, so they are ONE class here (the detailed 2011 geology layer geology_units_map2011_pg separates them). Rivers, dotted lines and place markers on the sheet are absorbed into the surrounding class. Georeferenced by outline fit to the geology land mask. Compare with the detailed layer geology_units_map2011_pg for accuracy.
